"""Weekly food and labor cost report for small restaurants (prototype)."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class Week:
    revenue: float
    food_purchases: float
    labor_hours: float
    hourly_wage: float

    def food_cost_pct(self) -> float:
        return 100 * self.food_purchases / self.revenue if self.revenue else 0.0

    def labor_cost_pct(self) -> float:
        return 100 * self.labor_hours * self.hourly_wage / self.revenue if self.revenue else 0.0

def report(w: Week) -> str:
    return (f"Food cost: {w.food_cost_pct():.1f}% | Labor cost: {w.labor_cost_pct():.1f}% | "
            f"Prime cost: {w.food_cost_pct() + w.labor_cost_pct():.1f}%")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(report(Week(revenue=18000, food_purchases=5400, labor_hours=240, hourly_wage=18)))
EOF

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class Week:

    food_purchases: float
    labor_hours: float
